content.stem: 一家银行收到了一份针对其某位客户的传票.该银行的金融情报部门应当审查这份传票,并:

options.A: 通过告知客户传票一事来关闭客户的账户.
options.B: 进行交易审查并全面回应传票.
options.C: 提交可疑活动报告(SAR),并在报告叙述中包含收到传票的情况.
options.D: 调整客户的风险评分并结案

content.stem_en: A bank received a subpoena regarding one of its clients. The financial intelligence unit of the bank should review the subpoena and:

options_en.A: Close the client's account by informing the client of the subpoena
options_en.B: Perform a transaction review and respond fully to the subpoena
options_en.C: File a suspicious activity report (SAR), including the receipt of the subpoena in the SAR narrative
options_en.D: Adjust the client's risk score and close the case
